needed.evidence: A trodden dirt strip serves as a path, lacking a formal sidewalk.
needed.suggestion: Construct a paved footway on the right side to provide a safe, dedicated space for pedestrians.

needed.evidence: The area beside the road is an informal, narrow strip, not a proper sidewalk.
needed.suggestion: Install a formal sidewalk on the left side to separate pedestrians from the roadway.

needed.evidence: The informal path on the right is uneven with visible debris.
needed.suggestion: Grade and level the informal path on the right to create a smooth, safe walking surface.

needed.evidence: The left side shows an uneven, unpaved surface next to the road.
needed.suggestion: Resurface the left-side path to eliminate trip hazards for pedestrians.

needed.evidence: There is no marked or physical crossing facility despite clear pedestrian activity and road users.
needed.suggestion: Provide a clearly marked pedestrian crossing to manage the high demand for crossing at this location.

needed.evidence: No street lights are visible along the length of the road in any frame.
needed.suggestion: Install street lighting along the road to improve visibility and safety for all road users during the night.
